title: A relatively flat module descends on a fixed affine-limit model
statement: Let $I$ be a directed partially ordered set, let $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ be a diagram of Noetherian rings, and let $S$ be an affine scheme with a limiting cone over the inverse system $\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Fix $i\in I$ and a finitely presented morphism $f_i:Z_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$, meaning locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $Z=Z_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $M$ be a finitely presented module on $Z$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] flat over $S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. There exist $j\ge i$ and a finitely presented module $M_j$ on $Z_j=Z_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$, flat over $\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$, together with an isomorphism between its tensor pullback along the canonical comparison $Z\to Z_j$ and $M$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pc-base-change].

proof.text: Apply finite-presentation module descent on the fixed source model to descend M to a finitely presented quasi-coherent module N at a stage j above i, retaining an isomorphism of its limit tensor pullback with M.

The comparison transports relative flatness of M to the limit pullback of N: on affine sections restrict scalars of its linear isomorphisms. Apply eventual flatness descent to N over the stage j; choose a later k where its pullback is flat. Tensor pullback preserves finite presentation.

Cartesian pasting identifies the iterated source with the direct base change from i to k. Compose the tensor-pullback composition isomorphism with the original descent isomorphism to recover M. No properness or derived-category construction is involved.

theorem exists_flat_module_on_later_stage
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Zi : Scheme.{u}} (fi : Zi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation fi] [QuasiCompact fi] [QuasiSeparated fi]
    (M : (pullback fi (c.π.app (Opposite.op i))).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hM : M.IsFlatOver (pullback.snd fi (c.π.app (Opposite.op i)))) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
      (Mj : (pullback fi (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules),
      Mj.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Mj.IsFlatOver (pullback.snd fi (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange fi
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (Opposite.op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (Opposite.op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Mj ≅ M)
